other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates time-based features (e.g., elapsed days, remaining days, or project expiration status) using the current system time (`pd.Timestamp.now()`) instead of a fixed reference date from the dataset context. summary: The solution is generally well-structured, employing safe out-of-fold target encoding, train-only TF-IDF/SVD fitting, and robust cross-validation with an optimized ensemble. However, there is a critical flaw in the temporal feature engineering: the agent uses the runtime timestamp (`pd.Timestamp.now()`) to calculate elapsed and remaining project days. Since the dataset is historical, this introduces extreme drift and renders these duration features meaningless, changing the model's output depending purely on the date the script is executed.
